Remark
[Classical interpretation] ↗ def:weak-sub-supersolution 1. ch9:9.3-rem-1\group Sub- and Supersolutions

If $\bar{u}, \underline{u} \in C^2(U)$, then from (3) and (4) it follows that \[ -\Delta \bar{u} \geq f(\bar{u}), \quad -\Delta \underline{u} \leq f(\underline{u}) \quad \text{in } U. \]
